desc:
This is the ultimate tool for the Glock® Armorers and enthusiasts. This handy multi-tool has five specific tools for the very popular Glock® pistols.
Magnetic 3/16” hex nut driver for the front sight
Channel liner removal tool
Hardened steel 3/32” (2.5mm) disassembly tool
Channel liner install tool
Flat blade and Phillips screwdriver bit.
